notes.title: LEAVES – The Journey - 1.0.1 Changelog - 3/14/2017
notes.notes:
Not only do we have part 2 available today, but also a small update:

These are the changes:

1. Steamworks-SDK update
2. Unity update
3. Fixed a bug that caused a missing background in the outro
4. Fixed a bug that deactivated the foot pedal in cave 3.
